models.title: Models
models.subtitle_gpu: Estimated for your {gpu}{others} and {ram} of RAM. Measure a downloaded model for exact numbers.
models.vram_others: ({n} of its VRAM in use by other programs)
models.subtitle_cpu: Estimated for your {cpu} and {ram} of RAM, without a GPU. Measure a downloaded model for exact numbers.
models.answer_note: Starts at once: the message is read while you type, and the answer is written ahead during your pauses.
models.tier.tiny: Tiny and instant: simple chats and quick drafts.
models.tier.balanced: Balanced: solid reasoning at full speed on most GPUs.
models.tier.strong: Strong: sharper reasoning, at its best with 8 GB of VRAM.
models.tier.very_strong: Very strong: careful reasoning, at its best with 12 GB or more.
models.tier.moe: Mixture of experts: big-model knowledge at small-model speed. Needs plenty of RAM.
models.tier.best: The largest: top quality, for 24 GB cards.
models.hint.gpu: Runs entirely on your GPU: the fastest setup.
models.hint.partial: Part of it runs on the CPU: it works, but slower, and less reasoning fits before Enter.
models.hint.too_big: Needs more memory than this machine has.
hardware.title: Hardware
hardware.subtitle: What MAFDET found on this machine, and the runtime that runs the models.
hardware.no_gpu: No NVIDIA card found: models run on the CPU.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Saved on this computer, kept from one start to the next.
settings.language.hint: The language of the interface. The model answers in the language you write in.
settings.think.hint: The model starts thinking about your message before you send it. Off: no reasoning, it answers right away.
settings.ahead.hint: Answer tokens written during a pause, while the message does not change.
settings.think_ahead.hint: The longest reasoning carried over while you keep typing.
settings.max_tokens.hint: 0 means as long as the context allows.
settings.ctx.hint: How much of the conversation the model keeps in memory. More takes more VRAM.
settings.device.hint: Auto uses the NVIDIA card when there is one.
settings.recycle.hint: Reuses the answers written for earlier versions of the message to write faster (+4% to +20% measured).
settings.gatherer.hint: A small model gathers material while you type and the main model reads it. Measured on the RTX 2060: no faster than reasoning ahead. For research.
settings.branches.hint: The model also guesses how you will finish the message and reasons on the guess. Measured on Qwen3-4B: it guessed the exact message about 1 time in 3; the wait was 16% shorter on average, mostly on the slowest answers. Only with models that fit in VRAM: on larger ones the guesses come too slowly. Takes more VRAM.
settings.toast.reload: Settings saved · the model is reloading
settings.about.body: Local LLMs that read and think while you type: the message is read as you write it, and a reasoning model starts thinking about it before you send it.
onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to MAFDET
onboarding.welcome.body: Local AI that reads your message while you type it, so the answer is ready the moment you press Enter. Setting it up takes about two minutes.
onboarding.hardware.title: Looking at your machine
onboarding.hardware.found_gpu: {gpu} with {vram} of VRAM: models will run on the GPU.
onboarding.hardware.found_cpu: No NVIDIA card: models will run on the CPU. Smaller models answer fastest.
onboarding.runtime.title: Installing the runtime
onboarding.runtime.body: llama.cpp runs the models. MAFDET picks the build for this machine: {label}.
onboarding.model.title: Your first model
onboarding.model.body: Chosen for your hardware. You can change it at any time in Models.
onboarding.ready.title: All set
onboarding.ready.body: Start typing and watch the line under the message: MAFDET reads and thinks while you write.
